name: libp2p_module
description: Libp2p network protocol module for Logos
author: Logos Core Team

config.description: JSON config — inline, or a path to a JSON file — overlaid onto the default options when the module is loaded. Every key is optional; an omitted key keeps its default. The same schema is accepted at call time by createNode, which rebuilds the node before start.

schema.bootstrapNodes: array<{ peerId: string, addrs: array<multiaddr string> }> — DHT bootstrap peers
schema.transport: string — "tcp" | "quic" ("quic-v1" accepted as an alias for "quic")
schema.privKey: string — hex-encoded raw private key bytes; gives the node a stable peer identity across restarts. Omit to generate a fresh key on each start.
schema.natPortMappingAuto: bool — enable gateway port mapping with automatic protocol selection; mutually exclusive with every other port mapping mode
schema.natPortMappingUpnp: bool — enable gateway port mapping restricted to UPnP-IGD; mutually exclusive with every other port mapping mode
schema.natPortMappingNatPmp: bool — enable gateway port mapping restricted to PCP/NAT-PMP; mutually exclusive with every other port mapping mode
schema.natExplicitIp: string — announce this external IP instead of discovering a gateway mapping; mutually exclusive with every other port mapping mode
schema.natDiscoveryTimeoutMs: int — gateway discovery timeout; values <= 0 use the core default
schema.natMappingTimeoutMs: int — gateway mapping request timeout; values <= 0 use the core default
schema.natReachabilityV1: bool — enable NAT reachability probing with AutoNAT v1; mutually exclusive with natReachabilityV2, autonatV2, and hole punching
schema.natReachabilityV2: bool — enable NAT reachability probing with AutoNAT v2; mutually exclusive with v1 and hole punching
schema.natReachabilityScheduleIntervalMs: int — reachability probe interval; values <= 0 disable the scheduling override
schema.natHolePunching: bool — enable AutoNAT v1, AutoRelay, and DCUtR hole punching; mutually exclusive with natReachabilityV1, natReachabilityV2, and autonatV2
schema.natHolePunchingMaxNumRelays: int — relay reservation target for hole punching; values <= 0 use the core default
schema.natHolePunchingScheduleIntervalMs: int — hole-punch reachability probe interval; values <= 0 disable the scheduling override
schema.gossipsubQueueMaxMessages: int — messages held per topic for gossipsubNextMessage; default 1024. Once full the newest message is dropped and counted in libp2p_module_gossipsub_queue_dropped_total.
schema.gossipsubQueueMaxBytes: int — bytes held per topic for gossipsubNextMessage; default 4194304. Both bounds apply together, and a message larger than this bound never fits, so keep it above gossipsubMaxMessageSize. Set either bound to 0 to disable the queue for consumers that only read the gossipsubMessage event.
schema.gossipsubMaxMessageSize: int — largest GossipSub message accepted or sent, in bytes; default 0 keeps the core 1 MiB limit. The ceiling is MAX_GOSSIPSUB_MESSAGE_SIZE (67108864).
schema.gossipsubOverheadRateLimitBytes: int — per-peer budget of protocol-overhead bytes per interval; default 0 disables the limit. Needs gossipsubOverheadRateLimitIntervalMs.
schema.gossipsubOverheadRateLimitIntervalMs: int — refill interval of that budget, up to MAX_OVERHEAD_RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL_MS. Needs gossipsubOverheadRateLimitBytes.
schema.gossipsubDisconnectPeerAboveRateLimit: bool — disconnect a peer that spends its budget; default false counts hits only. Needs a budget. Every gossipsub limit needs mountGossipsub.
